name: Google Sheets MCP Server
description: Enables AI assistants to access, search, and analyze Google Spreadsheets through the Model Context Protocol. Supports both OAuth 2.0 for private sheets and API key authentication for public sheets, with tools for listing, reading, and searching spreadsheet data.
